display.purpose: Hero headlines on the landing page only. Never in the chat app.

headline.purpose: Section headings (Features, PRD Builder). Used for conversation subjects in chat.

body.purpose: All prose, descriptions, chat messages. Max width 65ch.

label.purpose: TUI inset titles, tab labels, badge text. Always uppercase, always mono.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, terminal prompts, option card values. Never for body copy.

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest. Directional lift, not ambient.

shadows.name: cta-lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover. Intensified lift with -2px translateY.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transitions for buttons, borders, color changes.

motion.name: architecture-line-draw
motion.purpose: Landing page architecture line draw-on animation.

motion.name: feature-line-draw
motion.purpose: Feature card border draw-on via clip-path, staggered 100ms per card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA. Dark fill, white text, subtle lift shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f5f4; color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(245,245,244,0.12); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e7e5e4; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(245,245,244,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9e9e9e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent fill, subtle border, hover fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #f5f5f4; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,244,0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(245,245,244,0.4); background: rgba(245,245,244,0.04); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9e9e9e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: TUI Panel
components.description: Terminal-inspired panel with inset title label overlapping the top border.
components.css: .ds-tui-panel { position: relative; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,244,0.16); border-radius: 6px; background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-tui-inset-title { position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 12px; z-index: 1; padding: 0 6px; background: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #a8a29e; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: TUI Active Tab
components.description: Yellow-filled tab indicating the active conversation branch.
components.css: .ds-tui-tab-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: #facc15; color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 2px; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-tui-tab-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9e9e9e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Bento grid card with border draw-on animation on scroll entrance.
components.html:
✦Real-time

Chat Bebas & Natural

Tanyakan apa saja dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang mengalir natural.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px; min-height: 200px; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; background: transparent; } .ds-feature-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(245,245,244,0.25); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 0, 0 0); animation: ds-feature-line-draw 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-feature-line-draw { 0% { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 0, 0 0); } 25% { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 0, 0 0); } 50% { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 0); } 75% { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } 100% { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text input with focus ring. 40px height, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #f5f5f4; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #9e9e9e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(158,158,158,0.3); }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Fixed landing page header with hairline progress bar and scroll-aware background.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245,245,244,0.1); background: rgba(10,10,10,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }

components.name: TUI Working Badge
components.description: Yellow badge indicating the AI is actively generating a response.
components.css: .ds-badge-working { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: #facc15; color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

narrative.overview:
A dark-first professional workspace that feels like a well-organized toolbench at midnight: everything has its place, nothing is wasted, and the only light comes from the work itself. The terminal aesthetic is not nostalgia — it is a commitment to clarity over decoration. Every element earns its pixels. Yellow appears sparingly, like a single illuminated control on an otherwise matte surface, marking only what is active, selected, or complete.

The system balances two worlds: the chat app (dense, functional, TUI-terminal) and the landing page (spacious, architectural, demonstration-driven). They share a palette but diverge in density — the app is a workspace, the landing is a showcase.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black backgrounds with stone-gray tonal layering
Yellow accent used exclusively for active/selected/completed states (≤10% of screen area)
Terminal-inspired panels with inset labels and monospace chrome
Hexagonal mesh as structural metaphor, not decoration
Purposeful motion: scroll reveals, line draws, breathing nodes — never decorative spin
Dark by default; light mode is a courtesy override, not a parallel identity

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: The yellow accent appears on no more than 10% of any given screen. Its rarity is its signal — when yellow appears, the user knows something is active, selected, or complete.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace type appears only in three contexts: TUI panel chrome (inset titles, tabs), code/output, and data labels. Never for body copy, never for decorative quotes.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only in response to user action (hover, focus) or as a deliberate lift for primary CTAs. Dialogs and modals use opacity overlays, not elevation.

dos: Do keep yellow rare. It signals state, not style.
Do use mono type for TUI chrome only — inset titles, tabs, prompts, code.
Do let the hex mesh serve as atmosphere, never as content.
Do animate with purpose: reveal on scroll, draw on interaction, breathe on load.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — disable all non-essential animations.
Do use tonal layering (surface vs. background) for depth, not shadows.
donts: Don't use yellow for decorative elements, backgrounds, or large fills.
Don't mix serif (Lora) into the chat app — it belongs on the landing page only for editorial accents.
Don't add shadows to panels, cards, or TUI elements. Only the primary button gets elevation.
Don't round the hero chat mockup corners — they stay square as a deliberate contrast.
Don't use more than two type families in the chat app. Three on the landing is the maximum.
Don't let the mesh canvas accept pointer events — it's texture, not interface.
